findings.highlight: Does she think I can use Archer's arm already...?
findings.evidenceJa: てっきりアーチャーの腕を使えるかって話だと思った
findings.governingReading: てっきり...話だと思った is what Shirou had assumed the discussion concerned.
findings.explanation: His mistaken reading of her question becomes her belief about his ability.

findings.highlight: No matter what happens, I won't make you use Archer's arm.
findings.evidenceJa: どんな状況になろうとアーチャーの腕だけは使わせない
findings.governingReading: 使わせない prohibits allowing him to use it under any circumstances.
findings.explanation: Not allowing use becomes not forcing use.

findings.highlight: if I start trying to use this arm.
findings.evidenceJa: この腕を自由にすればどうなるか
findings.governingReading: 自由にすれば is releasing restraint, whose mere exposure is dangerous separately from actual power use.
findings.explanation: Freeing the arm becomes beginning to use it.

findings.highlight: we need to thoroughly check that out.
findings.evidenceJa: いちいち確認とる必要なかったじゃない
findings.governingReading: 確認とる必要なかったじゃない is explicit negated necessity, irritated that Illya failed to disclose existing knowledge.
findings.explanation: No need to check becomes need to check thoroughly.

findings.highlight: it's your job to ask him.
findings.evidenceJa: 伝えるのはリンの役目でしょう
findings.governingReading: 伝える is telling/explaining to him because Rin wants him to Project.
findings.explanation: Rin’s duty to communicate the proposal becomes asking him.

findings.highlight: I don't agree with your direction at all.
findings.evidenceJa: 決して貴女の方針に賛同したからじゃない
findings.governingReading: 決して賛同したからじゃない distinguishes duty as reason for helping from endorsement as reason.
findings.explanation: Helping not because of endorsement becomes categorical disagreement.

findings.evidenceJa: 魂魄としての重みで相手を打倒する
findings.governingReading: 概念—魂魄としての重み states the nonphysical mechanism, with 魂砕き/アウトブレイカー as layered name.
findings.explanation: Conceptual/spiritual weight becomes crushing the very soul.

findings.highlight: so we can't expect to block or dodge it.
findings.evidenceJa: わたしたちだってあんなものを振るわれたら防ぐ事も躱す事もできない
findings.governingReading: し/わたしたちだって says shadow would be destroyed AND they too cannot block or dodge if targeted.
findings.explanation: Parallel hypothetical effects become shadow destruction causing their inability to defend.

findings.highlight: your problem is more basic than that.
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方の投影はそういうレベルの話じゃない
findings.governingReading: そういうレベルの話じゃない distinguishes his Projection’s special status from ordinary-mage Projection, leading to correction of methods.
findings.explanation: His Projection exceeds ordinary level becomes his problem being more basic.

findings.highlight: gathering as many ingredients as we can
findings.evidenceJa: 出来るだけ本物にそうように用意
findings.governingReading: 出来るだけ本物にそうよう is fidelity criterion, not number of components.
findings.explanation: Materials matching original as closely as possible becomes as many ingredients as possible.

findings.evidenceJa: 材料や元になる設計図も要らない
findings.governingReading: 材料や元になる設計図も要らない denies both physical and informational support requirements for arm-powered Projection.
findings.explanation: Arm Projection needing neither materials nor blueprint loses materials.

findings.highlight: 'strengthen' a Projection of something that already exists.
findings.evidenceJa: 元からあるものを“投影”で“強化”する
findings.governingReading: 元からあるものを is the object; 投影で is the means; 強化する the operation.
findings.explanation: Strengthening an existing object by Projection becomes Strengthening a Projection.

findings.governingReading: 出来の悪い refers to his poor attainment/aptitude for instruction.
findings.explanation: Poorly performing pupil becomes naughty pupil.

findings.highlight: jammed her finger inside in me.
findings.evidenceJa: ハラん中に指いれてくる
findings.governingReading: ハラん中 describes intrusion into his abdomen in remembered treatment.
findings.explanation: Inside in me has doubled incompatible locative construction.

findings.highlight: it's the only way to defeat Zouken.
findings.evidenceJa: 臓硯が倒せるなら文句はない
findings.governingReading: 臓硯が倒せるなら文句はない is conditional agreement based on usefulness.
findings.explanation: No complaint if it can defeat Zouken becomes the only way to defeat him.
